name: ca.resortfinder/resortfinder
title: ResortFinder
description: Research all-inclusive resorts, check recent package prices, and hand off to booking or an advisor.

tools.name: search_resorts
tools.description: Shortlist bookable all-inclusive resorts by country, region, audience (adults-only or family-friendly), price tier, vibe, cuisine or venue, swim-up bar or room, kids club, solo-traveller fit, or brand. Returns slug, name, destination, tagline, best-for tags and a resort page URL. Start here for any recommendation. priceBand and vibeKeywords only influence ranking; the other filters are strict. If nothing matches, suggestedRelaxations says which filter to loosen; do not invent resorts.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes for countries in our catalog: MX=Mexico, CU=Cuba, JM=Jamaica, BS=Bahamas, TC=Turks & Caicos, KY=Cayman Islands, DO=Dominican Republic, LC=St Lucia, AG=Antigua & Barbuda, BB=Barbados, SX=St Maarten, BM=Bermuda, GD=Grenada, GP=Guadeloupe, HT=Haiti, AW=Aruba, CW=Curaçao, CR=Costa Rica, HN=Honduras, PA=Panama, CO=Colombia. Filtering to a country we don't carry returns no results.

regions.description: Region labels. Use 'Cancun area' for the whole Cancun/Riviera Maya/Playa Mujeres/Cozumel cluster - most users mean this when they say 'Cancun'.

audience.description: Who the trip is for. Use adults-only for honeymoons, couples, kid-free trips. Use family-friendly when the user mentions kids or family.

priceBand.description: Approximate price tier. Used server-side as a soft ranking boost, not a hard filter, because many resorts do not yet have luxury_tier populated.

vibeKeywords.description: Free-form bestFor tag matches. e.g. ['couples', 'honeymooners']. Each keyword passes if it appears in any resort's bestFor tags.

diningKeywords.description: Cuisine or venue terms that must match structured restaurants or editorial dining text. Use for requests like 'Indian restaurant', 'Sutra', 'Taj', 'steakhouse', 'teppanyaki', or 'vegan'.

hasSwimUp.description: Filter to resorts with a swim-up bar. Do not use this for swim-up room or swim-up suite requests.

hasSwimUpRoom.description: Filter to resorts with at least one swim-up room or swim-up suite category.

hasKidsClub.description: Filter to resorts with a kids club.

soloTraveler.description: Use for a traveler staying alone. Requires medium/high solo-specific evidence and must not be treated as an adults-only alias.

brand.description: Filter by chain, brand, property family, or named resort. Accepts names like 'Moon Palace', 'Planet Hollywood', 'Riu Palace', 'Hyatt Ziva', 'Grand Palladium', or slugs like 'riu'. Use ONLY when the user explicitly mentions a chain, brand, property family, or named resort.

excludeSlugs.description: Resort slugs that must not appear in this search, usually prior recommendation cards. The server also injects prior cards even if you omit this.

maxResults.description: Cap on rows returned. Default 40. Use a smaller number (10-15) when you want only the top matches.

tools.name: get_resort_details
tools.description: Detailed research for 1 to 5 resort slugs in one call: nine traveller lenses (food, pool, beach, quiet, value, couples, families, solo, what to know) each with a summary, positives, negatives, verdict and confidence; recent guest-review intelligence; rooms; restaurants and bars; observed package price signals; and links to TripAdvisor and the resort's own site. Review evidence covers the last 12 months only, so qualify low-confidence lenses. Slugs listed in notFound are not in the catalog.

slugs.description: 1-5 resort slugs from search_resorts or search_recent_package_prices results. Batch your finalists.

tools.name: search_guest_reviews
tools.description: Verbatim guest-review snippets from the last 12 months for one resort and one theme, such as 'food quality', 'noise', 'kids club' or 'sargassum'. Use when the traveller wants proof or raises a specific worry. Returns up to 5 snippets, most recent first, with source links where available.

slug.description: Resort slug from search_resorts or search_recent_package_prices results.

theme.description: Short theme phrase, e.g. 'food quality', 'noise', 'kids club', 'sargassum', 'swim-up bar'.

maxResults.description: How many snippets to return. Default 3.

tools.name: get_best_price_chart
tools.description: The most recent weekly snapshot of ResortFinder's Best Price chart for one Canadian departure airport: the lowest advertised package price by month for a resort, area or destination, for 7 days, 2 adults, 1 room. Use it for 'when is it cheapest' and month-to-month comparisons. Figures are advertised minima in the chart's displayed dollars, not live prices, not availability and not a quote for another party size. Quote the capturedAt date. N/A means no price was displayed, not sold out.

departureAirportCode.description: Required exact three-letter Canadian gateway, e.g. YEG, YYC or YYZ.

months.description: Requested YYYY-MM months; omit for the whole captured 12-month chart. Use current/next occurrence of month-only requests.

resortSlugs.description: Exact catalog slugs, including the correct resort from follow-up card context.

resortNames.description: Exact provider chart hotel names when a catalog slug is unavailable.

destination.description: Country or area text, e.g. Mexico, Playa Mujeres or Punta Cana.

level.description: hotel for resort rows; destination for country minima; area for destination-area minima.

tools.name: search_recent_package_prices
tools.description: Cheapest recently observed flight-inclusive package per resort for a Canadian departure airport and month, with per-person and total CAD price, departure date, sample count and when it was last seen. Use it to rank resorts by price or apply a per-person budget. A departure airport is required. Defaults are 7 nights and 2 travellers. maxPricePerPersonCad and minStarRating are strict filters. These are stored observations: say when each was last seen and that the final price is confirmed at checkout.

departureAirportCode.description: Exact IATA departure gateway code, e.g. YYC for Calgary, YYZ for Toronto Pearson, YUL for Montreal.

departureAirportCity.description: Departure city fallback when the airport code is unknown, e.g. Calgary.

nights.description: Package length in nights. Default to 7 for SunVoyage price questions when the user does not specify.

travelerCount.description: Total travelers represented by the package price history. Default to 2 for current SunVoyage price questions when the user does not specify.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes for countries in our catalog: MX=Mexico, CU=Cuba, JM=Jamaica, BS=Bahamas, TC=Turks & Caicos, KY=Cayman Islands, DO=Dominican Republic, LC=St Lucia, AG=Antigua & Barbuda, BB=Barbados, SX=St Maarten, BM=Bermuda, GD=Grenada, GP=Guadeloupe, HT=Haiti, AW=Aruba, CW=Curaçao, CR=Costa Rica, HN=Honduras, PA=Panama, CO=Colombia.

regions.description: Region labels. Use 'Cancun area' for the Cancun/Riviera Maya/Playa Mujeres/Cozumel cluster. Valid labels: Cancun area (all nearby), Cancun area, Cancun, Riviera Maya, Playa Mujeres, Cozumel, Puerto Vallarta, Los Cabos, Other Mexico, Punta Cana, Cap Cana, La Romana, Puerto Plata, Other DR, Negril, Montego Bay, Ocho Rios, Runaway Bay, Cuba, Bahamas, Turks & Caicos, Cayman Islands, St Lucia, Antigua & Barbuda, Barbados, St Maarten, Bermuda, Grenada, Guadeloupe, Haiti, Aruba, Curaçao, Costa Rica, Honduras, Panama, Colombia.

destinationQuery.description: Free-text destination fallback, e.g. Cancun or Punta Cana. Prefer regions when the user names a known region.

maxPricePerPersonCad.description: Hard per-person CAD ceiling. Required whenever the visitor states a per-person maximum budget.

minStarRating.description: Hard minimum supplier-listed star rating. Use only when the visitor explicitly states a star requirement.

maxResults.description: Cap on price rows returned. Default 8.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Build the link that lets the traveller book one resort. With a Canadian departure airport, date, nights and an adults-only party it returns bookingUrl: a ResortFinder page with the trip prefilled, one click from live packages and secure partner checkout. For US travellers, parties with children, or resorts without self-serve search it returns advisorUrl instead, with the trip prefilled for a free advisor. Read status and nextStep and relay them. This tool does not book, hold or charge anything, and creates no record.

market.description: Where the traveller departs from: "ca" (default) for Canada, "us" for the United States. Ask if unknown.

departureAirportCode.description: Departure airport IATA code. Canadian gateways: YYZ=Toronto, YUL=Montréal, YOW=Ottawa, YHM=Hamilton, YKF=Waterloo, YYC=Calgary, YEG=Edmonton, YVR=Vancouver, YWG=Winnipeg, YQR=Regina, YXE=Saskatoon, YHZ=Halifax, YQB=Québec City, YYT=St. John's.

nights.description: Trip length in nights. 7 is the most widely available.

tools.name: get_advisor_quote_link
tools.description: Build a link to ResortFinder's free advisor request, prefilled with up to 5 shortlisted resorts and the trip details. Use it when the traveller wants a person to price or book, is comparing several resorts, has children, has a group, or has needs the self-serve search cannot express. The traveller adds their own contact details on the page. This tool sends nothing and creates no record.

resortSlugs.description: 0 to 5 exact resort slugs from search_resorts. Omit when the traveller has no shortlist yet.

market.description: Where the traveller departs from: "ca" (default) for Canada, "us" for the United States. Ask if unknown.

departureAirportCode.description: Departure airport IATA code. Canadian gateways: YYZ=Toronto, YUL=Montréal, YOW=Ottawa, YHM=Hamilton, YKF=Waterloo, YYC=Calgary, YEG=Edmonton, YVR=Vancouver, YWG=Winnipeg, YQR=Regina, YXE=Saskatoon, YHZ=Halifax, YQB=Québec City, YYT=St. John's.

nights.description: Trip length in nights. 7 is the most widely available.

tools.name: submit_advisor_request
tools.description: Send the traveller's trip request to ResortFinder's travel advisors, who reply to the traveller directly with current prices and can complete the booking. Advisor help is free. It creates a real request, emails the advisor team and sends the traveller a confirmation email. Before calling: collect name, email, departure city, travel timing and party; show the traveller a short summary of what will be sent; and get their explicit agreement, then set consentToContact to true. Call once per request. It does not book or charge anything.

consentToContact.description: true only after the traveller has seen the details and agreed to send them to ResortFinder and be contacted by an advisor.

name.description: Traveller's name, as they gave it.

email.description: Traveller's email, as they gave it. Never guess.

phone.description: Phone number. Required only when contactChannel is text or call.

contactChannel.description: How the traveller wants the advisor to reply. Default email.

market.description: Where the traveller departs from: "ca" (default) for Canada, "us" for the United States. Ask if unknown.

departureCity.description: City or airport the traveller flies from, e.g. 'Toronto', 'YYC', 'Chicago'.

departureDate.description: Fixed departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with nights.

earliestDepartureDate.description: For flexible dates: earliest day they could leave, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with latestReturnDate and nights.

latestReturnDate.description: For flexible dates: latest day they could be home, YYYY-MM-DD.

travelDatesNote.description: Timing in the traveller's words when exact dates are not known, e.g. 'March break 2027' or 'any week in February'.

childrenAges.description: One age per child, at the time of travel. Required when children is above 0.

resortSlugs.description: 0 to 5 exact resort slugs from search_resorts that the traveller is interested in.

budgetAmount.description: Budget as a number, in CAD for Canada or USD for the US, including flights, resort, taxes and fees. Optional.

budgetBasis.description: Whether budgetAmount is the total for everyone or per person. Required with budgetAmount.

notes.description: Anything else the advisor should know: priorities, concerns, occasion, room needs, what the traveller liked about each resort.
